setup.target: at least 2 critical violations at an initial cycle inspection

calibration.choice_rule: fit on the first half of the validation weeks, lower Brier score on the second half

operating_threshold.rule: the calibrated-probability cut-off that flags the stated capacity per week on average over the validation weeks, applied unchanged to the test weeks

bootstrap_over_test_weeks.what: resampling the test weeks with replacement (2000 draws, seed 0); the 5 seeds do not capture which weeks happened to be in the test window

secondary_target.target: at least 1 critical violation (the first-posed question)
